listing.name: Project Gotham Racing 3 — PGR3-recomp (jpneagle)
listing.summary: Small slice checked using scripted input/frame/audio captures; expect bugs. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Project Gotham Racing 3 Xbox360 Japan/Asia release only (En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko), title4D5307D1, default.xex built2005-10-30T23:26:30Z, as XGD2 ISO or complete extracted game files. North American/European releases are untested and expected incompatible; bundled GeometryWars gw.xex is unsupported.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use Windows source build then play.bat configuration/launch with own supported PGR3 XGD2 disc.

warnings: Small slice checked using scripted input/frame/audio captures; expect bugs.
